title: S09T04 - Finalize public repository governance, documentation, and support boundaries
description: Prepare the sanitized repository, documentation site, changelog, roadmap, contribution flow, security policy, release notes, issue templates, and stable/experimental support matrix.
acceptanceCriteria: A stranger can find installation, five-minute tutorial, concepts, troubleshooting, command reference, extension guide, compatibility, security, and contribution docs from the README.
The public repository contains no secret, private memory, unsafe dump, machine-specific path, unexplained generated state, or unsupported stability claim.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
